headline: OpenAI Acquires Software Startup Pierre Computer Company to Bolster Codex
raw_snippet: OpenAI said it was buying Pierre Computer Company, a three-year-old startup that builds software tools to help developers manage and review code. OpenAI's coding agent Codex is already using Pierre's open-source developer tools. Pierre had raised $23 million as of last October and was founded by former Coinbase engineers Jacob Thornton and Ian Ownbey.

headline: OpenAI Releases National Community Compact for Data Centers Post-Midterms
raw_snippet: Two days after the midterm vote, OpenAI released a National Community Compact for AI data centers. Key provisions: no more nondisclosure agreements in data center deals, residents won't pay for power infrastructure, clear data on water/noise/energy usage, local hiring goals, and public accountability reports. OpenAI said some projects may now be delayed.

headline: OpenAI Had 'Rough' First Half of Year Before Coding Revenue Takeoff, Brockman Says
raw_snippet: OpenAI president Greg Brockman told the Wall Street Journal the first half of 2026 was 'pretty rough' but the company saw a Q3 revenue inflection from its coding products, including new models and ChatGPT Work. Business customers now contribute more revenue than consumers. OpenAI is targeting an IPO next year.

headline: OpenAI's Big Backers Press the Brakes on New Fundraising Round
raw_snippet: OpenAI has slashed its latest fundraising round by at least a third, now targeting up to $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation (down from $30 billion at $1.5 trillion). SoftBank is in discussions to invest only hundreds of millions this time, versus its previous $30B+ commitments. An Emirati investor group including MGX is expected to be the largest investor with single-digit billions.

headline: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Search Volume Now Equivalent to 20% of Google's
raw_snippet: OpenAI says ChatGPT's search volume is now equivalent to 20% of Google's total search volume, a significant milestone in the AI search wars. The metric highlights ChatGPT's rapid growth as a search alternative.

headline: Uber's Jill Hazelbaker to Join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
raw_snippet: Uber's Jill Hazelbaker is joining OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, according to a report from The Information. The hire signals OpenAI's focus on government relations, communications and policy as it prepares for an IPO and navigates increasing regulatory scrutiny.

headline: New OpenAI Models Including Next-Gen Astra and Sol Expected Imminently
raw_snippet: New models from OpenAI could come as soon as Friday (Nov 6), according to people with knowledge of the models. Those models could include the next generation of its Astra, Sol and cyber-focused models, though timelines could change.

headline: Researcher Uses OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol to Find Critical Data Center Vulnerability in Ubuntu
raw_snippet: Charge Robotics CTO Max Justicz used a version of OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol meant for cybersecurity researchers to find a vulnerability in apt, the package management system for Ubuntu. The flaw could allow attackers to hijack websites and plant code on data center servers. Canonical patched the vulnerability. The discovery comes as part of OpenAI's Patch the Planet bug-fixing initiative.

headline: OpenAI Pledges Tens of Millions for Communities Amid Data Center Backlash
raw_snippet: OpenAI is pledging tens of millions for school lunches, parks and first responders in communities hosting AI data centers, as part of Big Tech's scramble to offer voters a new deal after restrictive ballot measures on data centers went 43-to-1 on Tuesday. Analysts say about 60% of planned 2028 AI data center capacity now risks delay.
